 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated Software Egineer ready to take us to the next level! If you have 4 years full-stack software development, strong experience building backend with .NET, and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Software Engineer to take features and functions from concept to production-level applications supporting our clients system and other mission-critical business applications. This position will be a full-time contract role and hybrid , requiring 2 days onsite and 3 days telework . 
 What You'll Do 
 Develop and maintain full-stack applications using Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Power Platform
 Take features and functionality from concept through design, development, testing, and production deployment
 Enhance and support the MetroAlerts notification platform and integrate it with key enterprise systems
 Analyze existing applications and implement new functionality without impacting core application performance
 Design and develop scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and customer engagement
 Build and consume REST APIs using .NET Core or Node.js on Azure
 Develop responsive, high-performance user interfaces using React or Angular
 Participate in data architecture design, application development, and process automation initiatives
 Improve application accessibility, user experience, quality, and overall system performance
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams using Agile methodologies
 Support enterprise integration efforts, quality assurance testing, defect resolution, and release activities
 Follow WMATA architecture standards, security requirements, governance practices, and deployment procedures
 What You'll Need 
 Required:
 Bachelor's degree in a relevant field and/or a combination of education and experience that provides an equivalent level of competency
 Minimum 4 years of professional software development experience
 Strong hands-on full-stack development experience with an emphasis on front-end design and development
 3-5 years of experience developing back-end solutions using .NET Core or Node.js in Azure environments
 Experience building and consuming REST APIs
 4 years of experience developing front-end applications using React or Angular
 Experience translating business and design requirements into responsive, production-ready user interfaces
 4 years of experience working with Azure services, including Container Apps, Azure Functions, Storage, Key Vault, and serverless integrations
 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows
 4 years of experience with unit testing, integration testing, quality assurance, and defect resolution
 Knowledge of enterprise application governance, architecture standards, and release management processes
 Experience working in Agile development environments
 Preferred:
 Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field
 Experience supporting highly available, mission-critical public-facing applications
 Experience with enterprise system integrations and process automation initiatives
 Experience with accessibility compliance and UX/UI optimization
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
